description: Large-Scale Multipurpose Benchmark Datasets For Assessing Data-Driven Deep Learning Approaches For Water Distribution Networks is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Andrés Tello, Huy Truong (University of Groningen). Andres Tello*, Huy Truong*, Alexander Lazovik, Victoria Degeler. Large-Scale Multipurpose Benchmark Datasets For Assessing Data-Driven Deep Learning Approaches For Water Distribution Networks. Engineering Proceedings. 2024; 69(1):50. https://doi.org/10.3390/engproc2024069050 (*) Both authors contributed equally. Update (04/09/2024): Citation is updated.We have added headers for CSVs and auxiliary data (duration time, edge list, ordered names.. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
